act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 4 (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Schedule I-A Art. 4 (Affidavit): 'AFFIDAVIT including an affirmation or Declaration in the case of persons by law allowed to affirm or declare instead of Swearing — Ten rupees.' Exemptions: affidavit for enrolment under the Army/Air Force Act; for the immediate purpose of being filed or used in any court; or solely to enable receipt of a pension or charitable allowance.
